About Satin Graphic

Two shops. One studio.

Satin Graphic started as a print shop. Satin Auto Wrap grew up wrapping fleets. We’ve brought both under one name, one facility and one team — so a client never has to choose which shop to call.

Contact us

Our story

Chapter 1

A print shop opens

Satin Graphic starts small — offset printing, signage and a growing list of local repeat clients.

Chapter 2

Satin Auto Wrap joins in

A dedicated vehicle wrap division builds out a climate-controlled install bay and a certified installer team.

Chapter 3

One studio, today

Both brands now share one facility, one design team and one point of contact for every service on this site.

Our facility

What’s on the floor

Large-Format Printers

Latex and UV flatbed presses for wrap film, banners and rigid signage.

Roll Lamination Line

Gloss, matte and satin laminate applied under heat and pressure for durability.

Climate-Controlled Install Bay

Dust-filtered, temperature-controlled bays for clean wrap and PPF installs.

Offset & Digital Press

Short and long-run printing for cards, brochures and collateral.

In-House Design Studio

Every proof — vehicle, print or apparel — is designed on-site before it’s produced.

Apparel Decoration

Screen print, embroidery and DTF presses for team and fleet uniforms.

Our values

How we work

01Precision

Templates and proofs are checked panel-by-panel before anything goes to print.

02Craftsmanship

Every wrap is installed by our certified in-house team — never subcontracted out.

03Turnaround

Print shop orders are ready in 7–10 business days (large format 2–5); most wraps install in a single day.

04Partnership

One point of contact from first sketch to final install, across every service.
